The '''Baros system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Dominus sector/Legends|Dominus sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Located on the far edges of [[The Slice/Legends|The Slice]], the system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Baros]], home of the [[Brubb]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. Its primary [[Star/Legends|star]] was [[Bari]]. During the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Battle in the Baros system|attacked]] [[Darth Ordrem]]'s Imperial forces in the Baros system.
